close_reason: Moved to fz-xxd.7: a compiler bug, not test-machinery work.
description:
## Symptom (verified at develop, fz2 debug build)

`fixtures2/00430_opaque_value_accessor.fz`: module `A` with `@type t :: opaque resource(integer)`, `def make(), do: make_resource(7, &dbg/1)`, `def get(h :: t), do: h.value`; `main` calls `A.get(A.make())`.

- `fz2 run` exits 1: `function_clause: the root process halted through a fault trap`.
- `fz2 interp` exits 1: `function_clause: no backend entry clause matched for executable ...`.

Both paths agree; there is no parity break. (An earlier version of this ticket said `run` printed 7 and passed: the 7 is the resource destructor `&dbg/1` firing at heap drop, and the exit status was misread.)

## Reduction

8 lines, no resources (`scratchpad p8p2/v10_opaque_any.fz`): `@type t :: opaque any`; `def get(h :: t), do: :ok`; `main` calls `A.get(1)`. Fails identically on both paths. Adding `@spec make() :: t` to the constructor does not help. Without `opaque`, or without the annotation, everything runs.

## Mechanism (reader, file:line verified against develop)

- `resolve.rs:150-160`: an `opaque` type definition publishes `opaque_of(tag)` — a pure nominal tag; the inner `resource(integer)` is validated then dropped. This matches the documented design (.agent/docs/set-theoretic-types.md, "Brands carry their inner; opaques are nominal tags"): an opaque tag is lattice-disjoint from plain structural values.
- `dispatch_reachability.rs:136-184` (called from `jobs/semantic.rs:193`) intersects the caller's argument type (`resource(a0)`) with `A::t`; the intersection is empty, so the clause is unreachable and `executable_facts.rs:487-501` materializes zero clauses. Native and interp both consume that one `ExecutableDispatch` (one implementation, shared upstream) and fault.
- Nothing in the language produces a value of type `t`: no construct tags a value with an opaque name. So a parameter annotated with an opaque type can never match. No passing fixture annotates a parameter with an opaque type.

## Open question (owner)

What produces a value of an opaque type? Candidates: the declaring module's own functions (values built inside the module are `t`); a spec on the constructor; a tagged-construction form. The fix follows from that answer. `Types::mint_owned_resource_aliases` (types/mod.rs:1418-1429) looks like an earlier attempt at this and has no callers.

## Found by

fz-p8p census: the only test driving 00430 (`port_planner_test.rs::opaque_value_accessor_inside_declaring_module_types_as_inner`) asserts only that the drive resolves.
title: A parameter annotated with an opaque type admits no value, so its clause is unreachable on every path
